semiconductor_relevance: High — Morphing Machines provides adaptive computing solutions and IP for AI/ML and HPC applications, which are critical in semiconductor design and integration.
summary: Morphing Machines Private Limited specializes in adaptive computing solutions, focusing on its REDEFINE™ architecture. This architecture is a runtime reconfigurable many-core processor designed for AI/ML, HPC, and data center applications. The company offers its technology as Soft IP for integration into customer SoC designs, ensuring efficient computation and resource management.
capabilities: Dynamic resource scheduling for AI/ML and HPC
